question: Why are the individual self’s cognition and action held to extend to all objects?
premises: The individual self is held to be omnipresent in this view.
Cognition and action belong to the individual self.
Omnipresence entails applicability to all objects.
inference: Therefore, the self’s cognition and action are held to have all objects as their scope.
plain_english: Because of the individual self’s omnipresence, its cognition and action are held to extend to all objects.
